results.title: French Journalist Alleges Jewish-Owned Businesses Were Singled Out During Marseille Riots
results.description: French journalist Paul Amar has alleged that Jewish-owned businesses were deliberately targeted during violent demonstrations that swept across France on Saturday, October 17, raising concerns about growing antisemitism as thousands of French Jews increasingly choose to immigrate to Israel.
